authority.OBDATA096: Canonical analytical claim identity, claim kind, support state, uncertainty state and evidence-basis authority.
authority.OBDATA097: Direct establishment and analytical inference are explicitly separated.
authority.OBDATA098: Material uncertainty, partial support and unresolved conflict are preserved.
authority.OBDATA099: Candidate-level analytical conclusion integrity rejects unsupported claims and requires SUFFICIENT upstream evidence.

doctrine: sufficient evidence does not automatically create a valid analytical conclusion
direct claims must be directly supported by referenced evidence
inference claims must identify both evidence and inference basis
unsupported claims cannot enter an eligible analytical conclusion
partial support cannot masquerade as full support
material uncertainty cannot masquerade as resolved certainty
non-SUFFICIENT candidate evidence cannot produce an eligible conclusion
known_boundary: OBDATA096-100 governs analytical conclusion integrity only. It does not determine a trade action.
sufficiency_state is currently a normalized input. The foundation integration audit must bind this layer to the actual OBDATA091-095 sufficiency assessment/receipt.
evidence_refs and inference_basis are explicit references but are not yet cryptographically bound to canonical admitted evidence receipts.

claim support and uncertainty states are explicit analytical declarations. Later engine integration must derive them from canonical evidence and reasoning authorities rather than trusting arbitrary caller assertions.
ELIGIBLE means analytically eligible only. It does not mean buy, sell, hold, contract selection, capital permission, broker permission or execution permission.
title: Analytical Conclusion Integrity Authority
